title: Replacing a Returned Payment on a Self-Storage Unit Rental Agreement: Terms and Tenant Payment Tool
content:
**Terms.** A tenant whose payment the bank returned replaces it with one payment the tenant authorizes over the phone by credit card, debit card or bank account, applied only to the agreement the returned payment was for and recorded against that returned payment. This applies to any Self-Storage Unit Rental Agreement on which the bank has returned a payment.

**When the amount is fixed.** The replacement amount is fixed only after the ledger carries a late fee for every billing period whose rent remains unpaid past its grace days. The replacement amount is not fixed until every payment the bank has returned on the agreement carries its returned-payment fee.

Put another way, the replacement amount is settled from the ledger only once, for that agreement, no billing period whose rent remains unpaid past its grace days is without its late fee, and no payment the bank has returned is without its returned-payment fee.

## The tenant's payment tool

The replacement is paid with `pay_unit_returned_balance_f137f581`, a tool the customer themselves runs: the agent unlocks it and hands it over, and the tenant authorizes the payment from the tenant's own card or bank account. One call records one payment on the agreement's tenant ledger, dated today, taken through the care center phone line and tied to the returned payment it replaces, and lowers the agreement's balance due by the amount paid; any part of the payment above the balance due stays on the agreement as a credit balance.

| Parameter | What it is | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `rental_id` | the storage unit rental agreement number the payment is for, as the agent reads it from the rental agreement lookup and passes it to the tenant | identifier |
| `reference_entry_id` | the ledger entry number of the payment the bank returned that this payment replaces, as the agent reads it from the agreement's ledger lookup | identifier |
| `payment_method` | how the tenant pays | enum, see below |
| `amount` | the amount the tenant pays, in US dollars | 2 decimal places, always positive; more places are rounded to the cent |

Values of `payment_method`:

- `credit_card` — a credit card the tenant reads out;
- `debit_card` — a debit card the tenant reads out;
- `ach_bank_account` — a one-time debit from a bank account the tenant reads out;
- `cash` — cash, which is handed over only at a facility office;
- `money_order` — a money order, which is handed over only at a facility office;
- `prepaid_rent_plan` — a month applied from a Bluegate prepaid rent plan, which is never a phone payment.

**Return.** The call succeeds when the receipt returns the new payment entry number: `entry_id`, `rental_id` (the agreement paid), `payment_method`, `reference_entry_id` (the returned payment replaced), `amount` (the amount paid), `entry_date` (today) and `balance_due` (the agreement's balance due after the payment; negative means a credit balance).
